summary: Iteration 18: Tested localStorage page state persistence across navigation for QuizArena, MockExamPage, and ChatPage. All core persistence features verified working.

issues: The 5-step onboarding modal re-appears for bnps@student.edu on every test session even after completion. There appears to be no backend persistence of 'onboarding completed' state, causing it to re-trigger. This interferes with testing and may affect real users who revisit in a new browser session.

action_items: MINOR: Onboarding modal appears to re-show for existing users on new sessions. Consider persisting 'onboarding_complete' flag in the backend (user profile) instead of only localStorage so it doesn't re-appear after cache clear.

features_verified.quiz_state_saved_to_localStorage: PASS - When quiz is active (phase=quiz), state is correctly saved to localStorage key 'aceit_quiz_state' including phase, quiz, answers, current
features_verified.quiz_state_restored_on_return: PASS - When navigating to /quiz with active quiz in localStorage, quiz resumes (exit-quiz-btn visible, setup screen hidden)
features_verified.quiz_persists_across_navigation: PASS - Navigate away to /dashboard then back to /quiz, quiz state is correctly restored
features_verified.exit_quiz_btn_visible: PASS - data-testid='exit-quiz-btn' (RotateCcw) is visible during active quiz phase
features_verified.quiz_reset_clears_localStorage: PASS - Clicking exit-quiz-btn calls reset() which triggers useEffect(phase='setup') → localStorage.removeItem('aceit_quiz_state')
features_verified.mock_exam_state_saved: PASS - When exam active, state saved to localStorage 'aceit_exam_state' with savedAt timestamp and examDurationSeconds
features_verified.mock_exam_state_restored: PASS - Navigating to /mock-exams with active exam in localStorage resumes exam (exit-exam-btn visible)
features_verified.mock_exam_timer_adjusted: PASS (code verified) - _saved calculation: elapsed = (Date.now() - savedAt)/1000; remainingSeconds = max(0, examDurationSeconds - elapsed)
features_verified.mock_exam_persists_across_navigation: PASS - Navigate away then back, exam still active
features_verified.exit_exam_btn_visible: PASS - data-testid='exit-exam-btn' (RotateCcw) visible during active exam
features_verified.mock_exam_reset_clears_localStorage: PASS - Clicking exit-exam-btn calls reset() which directly calls localStorage.removeItem('aceit_exam_state')
features_verified.mock_exam_submit_clears_localStorage: PASS (code verified) - submitExam() calls localStorage.removeItem('aceit_exam_state') before setPhase('result')
features_verified.chat_redirect_to_last_session: PASS - When localStorage has 'aceit_last_chat_session', navigating to /chat redirects to /chat/{sessionId}
features_verified.chat_invalid_session_handled: PASS - If session 404s, localStorage is cleared and user stays at /chat setup
features_verified.chat_localStorage_set_on_load: PASS (code verified) - loadSession() calls localStorage.setItem('aceit_last_chat_session', sid) on successful session load

seed_data_creation: Injected mock localStorage states for testing (quiz_state, exam_state) - not persisted to backend
context_for_next_testing_agent: All page state persistence (localStorage) features verified working: QuizArena saves/restores/clears quiz state, MockExamPage saves/restores/clears exam state with elapsed timer adjustment, ChatPage redirects to last session. One note: onboarding modal (5 steps) keeps re-appearing for bnps@student.edu test account - it seems there is no backend-side completion flag. This is unrelated to persistence feature.
rca_of_issues: Earlier test failures (TEST 6, MOCK TEST 4) for reset clearing localStorage were false negatives - the onboarding modal overlay was intercepting Playwright force=True clicks. Using direct JavaScript element.click() bypassed the modal overlay and confirmed both reset functions work correctly.
